description: Merge one person of a project's register into another when they are one human being — «Sjorgren» into «Sjogren». ASK the person first, naming both as list_persons shows them: 'similar' there is only a hint. Nothing is removed: the one merged keeps their spellings and facts with their sources, and from then on find_person, list_persons and the marks answer the other for any of their spellings. unmerge_person undoes it. Into a person already merged is into the one they were merged into; a rejected person is not merged into. Both journals keep a line. Members of the project who may write only. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

from.description: The person merged, as list_persons returned them.

name: merge_persons
